articles.summary: Dorian LPG Ltd. (NYSE: LPG) (“Dorian”), a leading owner and operator of modern very large gas carriers (“VLGCs”), today announced that it entered into an agreement with HD Hyundai to build one 90,000 cbm VLGC for delivery in July 2029 for a price of approximately $115 million. Dorian also has signed memorandums of agreement to sell the 2014-built Corsair and two 2015-built VLGCs for aggregate proceeds of approximately $256 million. Dorian expects to deliver each of the vessels to their purchasers by the fourth calendar quarter of 2026. There is no guarantee that these transactions will be completed by the fourth calendar quarter of 2026 or at all.
